ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why variance is real and one losing month proves nothing
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text: One losing month does not mean your edge is gone.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text: Most bettors quit after a cold stretch. They assume the system broke. What actually happened: variance hit, same as it always does.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text: At a 54% win rate, you will still lose 3 of 5 bets in a row more than once a month. That is not failure. That is math. The edge only shows up across hundreds of bets, not dozens.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text: Real example: flip a fair coin 20 times. You might get 8 heads. The coin is not broken. A bettor hitting 47% over 30 bets at a true 54% rate is well inside normal variance. It happens.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text: 259-221 on the year. There were losing weeks inside that. The edge held because the sample held. One month is noise. A full season is signal.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: One cold month doesn't erase your edge. Variance is the game. Stay in it long enough and the math catches up. 259-221 YTD, +40.1u.
